pages.cardNote: Welcome message from the student handbook
pages.title: Foreword

blocks.text: This handbook provides information regarding learner's involvement in the curricular, co-curricular and extra-curricular activities of the school. It serves as resource document of the policies, rules and guidelines of the school for any causes of action and decisions. This will clarity of action and decisions. This will clarify the relations among learners as well as the administration, faculty and staff. This handbook also includes information about the school, its services and facilities that the learners can avail. Through this, the learners will be properly guided and made aware of these responsibilities and obligation; as well as understand their commitment to the administration for their well-being.
To you learners welcome to Leonor M. Bautista National High School. You are all encouraged to study and enjoy the opportunities offered to you by this institution.

pages.cardNote: DepEd vision, mission, and core values
pages.title: Mission, Vision & Core Values

blocks.text: We dream of Filipinos who passionately love their country and whose values and competencies enable them to realize their full potential and contribute meaningfully to building the nation.
As a learner-centered public institution, the Department of Education continuously improves itself to better serve its stakeholders.
To protect and promote the right of every Filipino to quality, equitable, culture-based, and complete basic education where:

items: Learners learn in a child-friendly, gender-sensitive, safe, and motivating environment.
Teachers facilitate learning and constantly nurture every learner.
Administrators and staff, as stewards of the institution, ensure an enabling and supportive environment for effective learning to happen.
Family, community, and other stakeholders are actively engaged and share responsibility for developing life-long learners.

pages.title: Admission & Enrollment

items: The School adheres to the DepEd No Collection Policy which means no money shall be collected during enrollment period.

items.text: However, DepEd allows authorized collection for the following:

blocks.text: Admission Process: for Junior High School

items: Grade 7 are encouraged to register in the scheduled Early Registration date. Grade 8 to Grade 10 are considered pre-registered.

items.text: The following are required documents upon enrollment:
items: Certificate of Good Moral Character or Anecdotal Record for new learners
The permanent records (SF 10) of all incoming learners shall be secured before the end of first grading period (D.O. 54, s. 2016) by the class adviser.
Silence and order shall be maintained at all times in entering and leaving the classroom.
During class hours, learners shall always be attentive and cooperative refrain from doing things not connected with the whole class or lesson.
As a sign of respect, learners shall rise when called upon to recite or when propounding questions to the teachers.
Learners waiting to occupy a classroom shall enter only after the outgoing class has left the room.
Learners may leave the classroom only upon permission of the teacher.
Learners shall not eat in classroom only upon permission of the teacher.
Learners shall not cheat or commit any form of dishonesty in relation to their studies.
Learners shall keep the classroom clean and free from litter.
Loitering or creating any disturbance in the corridors or passageway is strictly prohibited.
Stairways and corridor shall be kept clean and clear for passage at all times.
Learners shall keep to the right when walking in the corridors and stairway.
Learners shall refrain from making unnecessary noise nor causing commotion of any kind or leave the hall during function.
Learners shall attend social function in clothing appropriate for the occasion and behave properly during school programs.
Learners shall refrain from using language and committing acts that are disrespectful, vulgar, or which in any manner may cause or tend to disturb other learners, faculty members and employees.

pages.cardNote: Rules on prohibited acts and offenses
pages.title: Alcoholism & Prohibited Acts

items: Learners shall not bring to school objects and pictures which are morally offensive or subversive.
Committing or inciting others common malicious damage in the personal property of a member of school, community or property owned by the school will not be tolerated.
Physical or verbal actions that leads to, or any may lead to violence are subject to disciplinary action.
Racist, sexist, derogatory, abusing or hanging behavior are not tolerated.

Any type of unwelcome conduct, verbal or non-verbal in the forms of demeaning slurs, name calling, gestures, or other words, and action relating to race, color, national origin, religion, gender, life style or handicap will result in disciplinary action,
Smoking in classroom and during academic function is prohibited.
There will be no smoking at any time in common areas and any building or on school property.

items.text: Bullying are subject to disciplinary action

1st offence : referred to Guidance Office;
items: Given failing grades on test / assignment; parent contact

items: Parents are now required to be a part of the discussion about how schools will help learners meet their academic performance standard.
Parents are welcome in the school and are encouraged to make a mutual convenient appointment with the teachers to discuss any area of concern.
It is the responsibility of parents to ensure that learners are in classes and to notify the school when the learners are absent.

blocks.text: Our main forms of communication to parents are:
Students should attend classes and school-sponsored activities regularly and follow the school’s current attendance procedure.

items: The handbook discusses tardiness, admission slips, and contacting parents or guardians for repeated attendance concerns.
Absences should be explained using the school’s accepted procedure and documentation.
For an individual concern, speak with the class adviser or Guidance Office. Confirm all current rules with the school.
